item.text: The index writers don’t check whether parent records are archived, and search trusts stale index entries. Restore has no search handler, and rebuild only reads the first page without clearing old entries. I’ll add visibility checks at write and query time, remove archived descendants, and paginate restore and rebuild.

from pathlib import Path
Path('tests/services/search-visibility-local.test.ts').unlink()
p=Path('src/server/jobs/search-reindex-job.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace(' * Walks one tenant\\'s projects, issues and comments and re-upserts every\\n * document.', ' * Clears one tenant\\'s stale documents, then walks all pages of its content.')
s=s.replace(' * Archived rows are read too: the rebuild is what brings a restored project\\'s\\n * content back, so it hands every row to the index writers and leaves the\\n * \"is this searchable?\" decision to them.', ' * Index writers check each row and its ancestors before adding a document.')
lines=s.splitlines()
# Indent the bodies of the newly added page loops.
for start,end in [('    const projects =','    projectCursor = projects.nextCursor;'),('    const issues =','    issueCursor = issues.nextCursor;')]:
 a=next(i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith(start))
 b=next(i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith(end))
 for i in range(a,b+1):
  if lines[i]: lines[i]='  '+lines[i]
a=next(i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.strip().startswith('const comments ='))
b=next(i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.strip()=='commentCursor = comments.nextCursor;')
for i in range(a,b+1):
 if lines[i]: lines[i]='  '+lines[i]
p.write_text('\\n'.join(lines)+'\\n')
PY"
